test_policy: Do not read test until preprocessing and K are frozen.

preprocessing_modes.raw: No learned preprocessing; six spending columns in original units.
preprocessing_modes.log1p_standardscaler: np.log1p then StandardScaler fit on train only; validation uses transform only.

stability_metric: mean pairwise Adjusted Rand Index on train assignments across seeds
selection_rule: Review validation silhouette, elbow/inertia, ARI stability, cluster sizes and interpretability together. Do not auto-select K from one metric.

k2.note: Simple reproducible K=2 reference; not the final model decision.
